::: {.lead-intro}
I'm Eriola, a Government Operational Researcher and geospatial analyst. I've worked with quantitative, geospatial and statistical methods for more than 15 years, in government, academia and the private sector. Here I share my projects and write about making messy data clear, explaining uncertainty, and how AI is changing the way I work with spatial data.
:::

## Featured projects

::: {.cards}
::: {.card-et}
### Last orders? The UK drawn with its pubs
<p class="meta">Data story · Python · FSA and ONS open data</p>

I drew the UK with 38,000 pubs and bars, checked whether COVID closed them (the big drop came in 2008), and went through the pub names. You can check how pubby your postcode is too.

<p class="links"><a href="https://etymo.co.uk/uk-pubs/">Read the story</a> <a href="posts/2026-10-uk-pubs/">Write-up</a></p>
:::

::: {.card-et}
### Can you draw Greece with tavernas?
<p class="meta">Data story · Python · OpenStreetMap and ELSTAT</p>

I tried to do the same with Greek tavernas, and found out how hard it is to find the data in Greece. The map turned out to show where tourists go as much as where the tavernas are.

<p class="links"><a href="https://etymo.co.uk/greek-tavernas/">Read the story</a> <a href="posts/2026-10-greek-tavernas/">Write-up</a></p>
:::

::: {.card-et}
### Can you draw Albania with its bar-kafe?
<p class="meta">Data story · Python · OpenStreetMap and INSTAT</p>

After the pubs and the tavernas, I couldn't leave out Albania, my country of origin. Albania's Red Lion turns out to be called "Bar Kafe".

<p class="links"><a href="https://etymo.co.uk/albania-kafe/">Read the story</a> <a href="posts/2026-10-albania-kafe/">Write-up</a></p>
:::

::: {.card-et}
### Pedestrian casualties on London's roads
<p class="meta">Spatial analysis · Python · Interactive dashboard</p>

I looked at 22,108 pedestrian casualties in Greater London from 2021 to 2025: where they happen along the streets, which parts of the built environment go with them, and how far serious casualties are from trauma care.

<p class="links"><a href="https://etymo.co.uk/london-pedestrian-safety/">Open the dashboard</a> <a href="posts/2026-10-athens-to-london/">Read the story</a></p>
:::

::: {.card-et}
### Article 4 and constraints checker, Kingston
<p class="meta">Planning tool · JavaScript · Planning Data API</p>

I built this to help with Local Land Charges searches at the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames. It checks one property, or a whole CSV of them, for Article 4 directions, conservation areas, listed buildings, flood zones and more, and flags cases close to a boundary.

<p class="links"><a href="https://etymo.co.uk/Article4Kingston/">Open the checker</a> <a href="projects.html">More projects</a></p>
:::

::: {.card-et}
### Ten years of pedestrian collisions in Athens
<p class="meta">Story and emergency dashboard · Python · from my MSc thesis</p>

My MSc thesis, rebuilt: where pedestrians were hit in Athens from 2008 to 2017, the streets where it kept happening, what's around them and how far help was. There's also an emergency services dashboard with the hospital duty rota.

<p class="links"><a href="https://etymo.co.uk/athens-pedestrian-safety/story.html">Read the story</a> <a href="https://etymo.co.uk/athens-pedestrian-safety/">Open the dashboard</a></p>
:::
